scripts.text:
[Scholar]
...Mm? 
...Yes?

[Scholar]
...
......
May I help you?
scripts.translation:
[學者]
...
......
有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text: Oh! N-Nothing!
scripts.translation: 沒什麼

scripts.text: Excuse me...
scripts.translation: 打擾一下...

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
You must be lost.
This is the scholarly
research section, you know,
content you couldn't possibly
fathom. The popular novels and picture books are someplace else.
scripts.translation:
[學者]
您一定是迷路了。
這裡是學術研究區，
裡面的內容您恐怕完全無法理解。
通俗小說和圖畫書在別的地方。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Why don't you rummage
through the bookshelves?
I'm sure you can find some
book there that can hold your
interest. Well, depending on
your actual attention span...
scripts.translation:
[學者]
您不妨在書架上翻翻看？
我相信您一定能找到
一本能引起您興趣的書。
當然，這取決於您的實際注意力...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(What's her damage?!
Does she have an attitude problem or is she just stuck-up?)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（她怎麼這麼兇？！
她是有態度問題，還是隻是高高在上？）

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
...Mm? 
...Yes?

[Scholar]
...
......
May I help you?
scripts.translation:
[學者]
...
......
有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text: Oh! N-Nothing!
scripts.translation: 沒什麼

scripts.text: By any chance...
scripts.translation: 順便問一下...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
By any chance...
Are you conducting
research about Juperos?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
順便問一下...
您是在研究朱佩羅斯嗎？

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Why yes, that is
correct. But how did
you come to learn about
my current research project?
scripts.translation:
[學者]
是的，沒錯。
但您是怎麼知道
我當前的研究課題的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I managed to read
a thesis paper entitled,
''The Fall of Juperos,'' and
I just thought that the writing
style and your personality
seem to match for some reason.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，我剛好讀到一篇
題為《朱佩羅斯的衰落》的論文，
我只是覺得您的文風
和您的性格似乎很匹配，不知為何。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Oh...! You read my
thesis? So what did
you think about it?
scripts.translation:
[學者]
哦...！您讀了我的論文？
那您覺得怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So far, it's alright, but
quite frankly it's incomplete.
I mean, you don't have much in
in the way of conjecture, much
less any evidence to back up
any of your statements.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
目前來看還可以，但
坦白說，它並不完整。
我的意思是，您在推測方面
著墨不多，更不用說
有任何證據來支援您的論點了。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
....
Let me apologize for
being rude to you earlier.
As you know, my name is
Fayruz Khrhiyha. May I ask
what your name might be?
scripts.translation:
[學者]
....
請允許我為剛才的無禮
向您道歉。
如您所知，我的名字是
法伊魯茲·克赫裡哈。請問
您怎麼稱呼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm {1},
a brave adventurer in the
service of his royal majesty,
the wise and benevolent
King Tristram III.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是{1}，
一位勇敢的冒險者，
受僱於英明仁慈的
特里斯坦三世國王陛下。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Well, {0},
I understand that my thesis
still requires more evidence.
But I'd need some ancient
documents from Juperos
to complete my research...
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
嗯，{0}，
我明白我的論文
還需要更多的證據。
但我需要一些來自朱佩羅斯的
古代文獻來完成我的研究...

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
If you happen to travel
through Juperos and find
any ancient documents, would
you bring them to me? Having
those would help my research
efforts immensely. Thank you...
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
如果您有機會
前往朱佩羅斯旅行，並找到
任何古代文獻，您能
把它們帶給我嗎？
這將極大地幫助我的研究工作。
謝謝...

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Ah, it's you! Listen,
I just found a record of
an adventurer who explored
Juperos. There's mention
of a stone statue here that
just might be noteworthy...
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
啊，是你！聽著，
我剛剛發現了一份
探險家探索朱佩羅斯的記錄。
這裡提到了一尊石像，
可能很有價值...

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
If you happen to find
yourself in Juperos,
would you find the stone
statue at the entrance of
its dungeon and read the
engraved message for me?
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
如果您有機會
來到朱佩羅斯，
您能去地牢入口找到那尊石像，
併為我讀取上面的銘文嗎？

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
According to my notes,
there's a spell that will
make its reader memorize
its message, even if they don't
know the language. So come
to me if you manage to read it.
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
根據我的筆記，
上面刻有一個咒語，
能讓閱讀者記住銘文內容，
即使他們不懂那種語言。
如果你能讀出來，
就來找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
If you ever chance to
travel through Juperos,
would you let me know if you
find anything that might help
my research there? I'd be
very grateful for your help.
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
如果您有機會
前往朱佩羅斯旅行，
能否告訴我您是否發現了
任何可能有助於我研究的物品？
我將不勝感激。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Well, you look
quite pleased.
May I ask what
happened to put that
expression on your face?
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
嗯，你看起來
心情不錯。
我可以問問
是什麼讓你露出
這樣的表情嗎？

scripts.text: I found something in Juperos.
scripts.translation: 我在朱佩羅斯發現了東西。

scripts.text: Nothing much.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I went to Juperos like
you asked and found that
stone statue you were talking
about. Just like you said, there was an engraved message on it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我按您的要求去了朱佩羅斯，
找到了您說的那尊石像。
正如您所說，
上面確實刻有銘文。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Fascinating!
So is it really enchanted
so anyone can memorize it?
Wh-what does the message say?
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
太棒了！
所以它真的被施了魔法，
任何人都能記住它嗎？
那...銘文上寫的是什麼？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou recite the message
engraved on the stone
statue, unable to interpret
the sounds you're uttering,
but weirdly enough, you can
easily recall them from memory.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你背誦石像上刻的銘文，
雖然無法理解發出的聲音，
但奇怪的是，
你能輕易地從記憶中
回憶起它們。^000000

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Ah, I see! Wait,
give me a moment to
properly translate this...
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
啊，我明白了！
等等，
請給我一點時間
好好翻譯一下...

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
It means, ''Do you wish to
see the end of the madness?
He is waiting where the three
columns were destroyed, where
two hundred illusions wander.''
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
意思是：
“你想看到瘋狂的終結嗎？
他在那三根柱子被毀的地方等待，
那裡有二百個幻覺在遊蕩。”

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
''You will see him, the one
who was vain and extravagant,
with your own eyes at the place where the light passes through.
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
“你將親眼見到他，
那個虛榮且奢靡之人，
在光線穿過的地方。”

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Ah, usually, descriptions
of the ''vain and extravagant
one'' refer to the mad scientist rumored to have lived in that
ancient era. But if this is true, I may have to rework my thesis...
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
啊，通常，
對“虛榮且奢靡之人”的描述
指的是傳聞中生活在那個
古代時代的瘋狂科學家。
但如果這是真的，
我可能得重寫我的論文了...

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
I have another favor to
ask of you. If you find any
object of historical significance in Juperos, would you bring it to
me? I'll reward you, of course.
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
我還有一個請求。
如果您在朱佩羅斯找到任何
具有歷史意義的物品，
能否帶給我？
當然，我會給您報酬。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
It would be most helpful
if you could manage to find
documents that existed from that era. Fortunately, back then,
they made all their records on material more durable than paper.
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
如果您能找到
那個時代存在的文獻，
那就最好了。
幸運的是，當時
他們記錄所用的材料
比紙張更耐用。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Nothing, huh?
My life is also fairly
uneventful, but somehow,
I'm don't think I'm content.
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
沒什麼嗎？
我的生活也相當平淡，
但不知為何，
我覺得自己並不滿足。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Oh hello, {0}.
So what brings you to
the Juno Library today?
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
哦，你好，{0}。
今天是什麼風把你
吹到朱諾圖書館來了？

scripts.text: Nice weather today, isn't it?
scripts.translation: 今天天氣不錯，不是嗎？

scripts.text: I found something in Juperos.
scripts.translation: 我在朱佩羅斯發現了東西。

scripts.text: Nothing much.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Well, I wouldn't know.
It's late whenever I go
out, so I always happen to
miss the sunlight. I guess
I really miss nice weather
sometimes, you know?
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
嗯，我不太清楚。
我出門總是很晚，
所以總是錯過陽光。
我想我有時候
真的很想念好天氣，你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Oh, really?!
That's great news!
W-what did you find?
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
哦，真的嗎？！
那是個好訊息！
你...你發現了什麼？

scripts.text:
^3355FFIn her excitement,
Fayruz begins to
rummage through your
things before you get
the chance to answer her.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在興奮中，
法伊魯茲開始翻找你的物品，
還沒等你回答她。^000000

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Oh, this must be it!
Would you mind if I keep
this Transparent Plate for
my research? In return, I'll
tell you some tales about
Juperos that I've learned.
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
哦，這一定是它！
你介意我把這塊透明碟仙惡靈
留作研究用嗎？
作為回報，我會告訴你
一些我在朱佩羅斯學到的故事。

scripts.text: Please, be my guest.
scripts.translation: 請，拿去吧。

scripts.text: No way, you can't have it.
scripts.translation: 不行，你不能拿走。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Mm? Are you serious?
This object is very valuable
to a researcher like me, but
I have no idea what use it
would be for an adventurer.
Well, you have your reasons...
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
嗯？你是認真的嗎？
這個物品對像我這樣的研究員來說非常珍貴，
但我不知道它對冒險者有什麼用處。
好吧，你有你的理由...

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Oh, really?!
That's great news!
W-what did you find?
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
哦，真的嗎？！
那是個好訊息！
你...你發現了什麼？

scripts.text:
^3355FFIn her excitement,
Fayruz begins to
rummage through your
things before you get
the chance to answer her.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在興奮中，
法伊魯茲開始翻找你的物品，
還沒等你回答她。^000000

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Oh. There isn't anything
here that would help in my
research, but thank you anyway.
If you find anything else while
you're in Juperos, please come back and show it to me, alright?
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
哦。這裡沒有什麼能對我研究有幫助的東西，
但還是謝謝你。
如果你在朱佩羅斯發現其他東西，
請回來給我看看，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Ah, I see. Well, while
you're here, why don't you
read something? There are
many books that cover some
interesting topics, like the
Schwarzwald economy...
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
啊，我明白了。既然你在這裡，
為什麼不讀點書呢？有很多書涵蓋了一些有趣的話題，
比如修瓦魯茲巴魯德的經濟...

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Oh, in any case, please
don't forget the favor I asked
of you. If you find anything
in Juperos that's historically
significant, I'd appreciate it
if you bring it right away.
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
哦，無論如何，請別忘了我拜託你的事。
如果你在朱佩羅斯發現任何具有歷史意義的東西，
我會感激你立刻帶過來。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Oh, {0}!
Have you come back with
something from Juperos?
I've been hoping you'd come
back with something that'd
help me in my research!
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
哦，{0}！
你從朱佩羅斯帶東西回來了嗎？
我一直希望你能帶一些能幫助我研究的東西回來！

scripts.text: Take a look at this.
scripts.translation: 看看這個。

scripts.text: Oh, I'm sorry...
scripts.translation: 哦，抱歉...

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Ah, I see. Well, while
you're here, why don't you
read something? There are
many books that cover some
interesting topics, like...
like... Self-Honesty (?).
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
啊，我明白了。既然你在這裡，
為什麼不讀點書呢？有很多書涵蓋了一些有趣的話題，
比如...比如...自我誠實 (?)。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Oh, in any case, please
don't forget the favor I asked
of you. If you find anything
in Juperos that's historically
significant, I'd appreciate it
if you bring it right away.
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
哦，無論如何，請別忘了我拜託你的事。
如果你在朱佩羅斯發現任何具有歷史意義的東西，
我會感激你立刻帶過來。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Oh, {0}!
The Transparent Plate
that you brought for me
last time is really helping me
in my research. If you get the
chance, please bring me more!
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
哦，{0}！
你上次帶給我的透明碟仙惡靈
對我的研究真的很有幫助。
如果有機會，請再給我帶一些！

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
This new data is adding
a lot more credibility to my
thesis. Oh, I'll be with you
in a moment, let me finish
translating this one last
passage really quickly...
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
這些新資料為我的論文增加了更多的可信度。
哦，我馬上就來，讓我快速翻譯完最後這一段...

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Hello, {0}~
Oh, were you able to look
in Juperos for anything that
might help me in my research?
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
你好，{0}~
哦，你在朱佩羅斯找過可能對我研究有幫助的東西嗎？

scripts.text: Yeah, take a look at this.
scripts.translation: 是的，看看這個。

scripts.text: No, I'm sorry...
scripts.translation: 不，抱歉...

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Oh, that's fine.
Besides, I don't really
have a deadline to complete
this research project. Still,
I just want you to know that
I really appreciate your help.
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
哦，沒關係。
而且，我完成這個研究專案也沒有真正的截止日期。
不過，我只是想讓你知道，
我非常感激你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
{0}...
I'm having great difficulty in
translating that Transparent
Plate you brought for me that
last time. I'm so frustrated...
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
{0}...
我在翻譯你上次帶給我的那個透明碟仙惡靈時遇到了很大的困難。
我很沮喪...

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Wait a minute...
This here means...
Alright. Okay. Yes.
Yes! Of course, how
could I not see it before!
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
等一下...
這個意思是...
好的。是的。
是的！當然，我之前怎麼沒看出來！

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
I'll be with you
in just a second!
I think I just made
a real through...!
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
我馬上就來！
我想我剛剛有了真正的突破...！

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Ah, I've been
expecting you, {0}.
So did you have been to Juperos again? I'm really hoping that you
were able to find something new that would help in my research...
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
啊，我一直在等你，{0}。
所以你又去朱佩羅斯了嗎？我真的希望你能找到一些新的東西來幫助我的研究...

scripts.text: Actually, I did find this...
scripts.translation: 其實，我找到了這個...

scripts.text: I'm sorry, I haven't...
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我沒有...

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Ah, I see. Well, while
you're here, why don't you
read something? There are
many books that cover some
interesting topics, like
modern adventure history.
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
啊，我明白了。既然你在這裡，
何不讀點什麼呢？
這裡有很多書，
涵蓋了一些有趣的主題，
比如現代冒險史。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Oh, in any case, please
don't forget the favor I asked
of you. If you find anything
in Juperos that's historically
significant, I'd appreciate it
if you bring it right away.
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
哦，無論如何，請別忘了我拜託你的事。
如果你在朱佩羅斯發現任何具有歷史意義的東西，
我會感激你立刻帶過來。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Oh hello, {0}...
So what exactly brings you
to the Juno Library this time?
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
哦，你好，{0}...
這次是什麼風把你吹到朱諾圖書館來了？

scripts.text: I found another Transparent Plate.
scripts.translation: 我又找到了一塊透明碟仙惡靈。

scripts.text: Just visiting, really.
scripts.translation: 只是隨便逛逛。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Hmm, well, we've made as
much headway as we can
with the Transparent Plates
you've already given me, but
it can't hurt to have too much
evidence to back my theories.
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
嗯，好吧，關於你已經給我的那些透明碟仙惡靈，
我們已經取得了儘可能多的進展，
但多收集一些證據來支援我的理論總是好的。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
I really appreciate
your continuing efforts
to help me. Please, would
you take this as my way
saying ''Thanks?'' You've been
great, {0}...
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
我非常感激你一直以來的幫助。
請收下這個，
作為我表達謝意的方式吧？
你做得很棒，{0}...

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Mmm...?
It doesn't look like
you brought another
Transparent Plate.
Are you sure that you
didn't misplace it?
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
嗯...？
看起來你並沒有帶來另一塊透明碟仙惡靈。
你確定沒有弄丟它嗎？

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Ah, I see. Well,
thanks to your help,
I've made a great deal
of progress on my thesis.
I really appreciate what you
have done for me, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
啊，我明白了。多虧了你的幫助，
我的論文取得了很大的進展。
我非常感激你為我所做的一切，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Thank you so much,
you don't know what
this means to me! Okay,
please relax and take a
seat. Close your eyes while
I tell you this ancient story.
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
非常感謝你，
你不知道這對我意味著什麼！
好了，請放鬆，坐個位置。
在我給你講這個古老故事的時候，
請閉上眼睛。

scripts.text:
^3355FFFayruz begins to
relate an ancient tale
about Juperos that seems
typical for a classic story, but her way of storytelling subtly
draws you into a vicarious, yet extremely vivid experience.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF法伊魯茲開始講述一個關於朱佩羅斯的古老傳說。
這聽起來像是一個經典的故事，但她講述的方式卻微妙地將你帶入了一段身臨其境、卻又極其生動的體驗之中。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou feel the protagonist's
glories and tragedies as if
you were actually there with
the hero on his journeys. The
tale eventually comes to an end
and you awaken from the trance,
gently brought back to reality.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你彷彿身臨其境，
與英雄一同踏上旅途，
感受著主角的榮耀與悲劇。
故事終於接近尾聲，
你從恍惚中醒來，
被溫柔地帶回了現實。^000000

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Everyone can relate
to these old, classic
stories. I hope this tale had
as meaning for you as it did
for me when I first heard it.
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
每個人都能對這些古老的經典故事產生共鳴。
我希望這個故事對你來說，
和我第一次聽到它時一樣有意義。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
If you can find me
another artifact from
Juperos, I'll share another
tale like that with you. Now
how does that sound? Okay
then, I'll see you, adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
如果你能再幫我找到一件來自朱佩羅斯的文物，
我會再給你講一個這樣的故事。
怎麼樣？
那麼，再見了，冒險者~

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Oh, that's unexpected.
This Transparent Plate
seems to have been made
in a different era than the
one you gave me earlier.
How intriguing...
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
哦，這出乎意料。
這塊透明碟仙惡靈似乎
製作於比你之前給我的那塊更早的時代。
真是有趣...

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
*Sigh* I really wish
that I could explore
Juperos on my own, but
I'm just not strong enough.
In a way, I'm quite jealous of you. But it can't be helped...
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
*嘆氣* 我真希望能親自去探索朱佩羅斯，
但我就是不夠強壯。
在某種程度上，我有點嫉妒你。但沒辦法...

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
You know, that reminds
me of this great story of
a tragic hero that I'd like to
share with you. Let your
mind wander as I relate this ageless, yet bittersweet tale...
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
你知道嗎，這讓我想起了一個關於悲劇英雄的精彩故事，
我想與你分享。
讓我帶你進入這個永恆卻苦樂參半的故事...
讓你的思緒隨著我的敘述飄遠吧。

scripts.text:
^3355FFFayruz tells you a story
with a bright beginning, full
of hope that fills you with the
bliss of the heavens, but then
suddenly plummets you into all the despair and torment of hell.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF法伊魯茲給你講了一個故事，
開頭充滿光明和希望，
讓你感受到天堂般的極樂，
但隨後突然將你拋入地獄般的絕望與折磨中。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe story finally
reaches its ending
and you're surprised
to find yourself sitting
in the Juno Library.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF故事終於講到了結尾，
你驚訝地發現，
自己正坐在朱諾圖書館裡。^000000

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
I know it's a very
depressing story, but
I hope you enjoyed it.
I think you'd agree that
it contains a truth about
mankind that can't be ignored.
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
我知道這是一個非常令人沮喪的故事，
但我希望你喜歡。
我想你會同意，
它包含了關於人類的一個不可忽略的真理。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
By now I'm sure you've
figured that these classic
tales are like condensed
experiences, refined and
immutable truths that we
can see in our own reality.
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
到現在，我相信你已經明白了，
這些經典故事就像是濃縮的經驗，
是我們能在自己的現實中看到的、
經過提煉且不可改變的真理。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
If you find more of
these Transparent
Plates in Juperos, I'd be
very happy to share another
story with you, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
如果你在朱佩羅斯找到了更多的透明碟仙惡靈，
我會很高興再與你分享另一個故事，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Oh, this one seems
to have been created
in a similar era as the
one you gave me earlier.
I'm not sure how much new
information this may provide...
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
哦，這個似乎與你之前給我的那個
製作於相似的時代。
我不確定這能提供多少新資訊...

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Still, I'm sure this will
helpful in my research. I just
won't be as making progress
as quickly as I had projected.
Please, I'd like you to take this as a token of my gratitude.
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
不過，我相信這對我的研究會有幫助。
只是我的進展不會像我預期的那樣快。
請收下這個，作為我感謝你的禮物。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Now if you'll excuse
me, I need to go back
to compiling my research...
Thank you so much for
your help, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
現在，請原諒我，
我需要回去整理我的研究了...
非常感謝你的幫助，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Oh. There isn't anything
here that would help in my
research, but thank you anyway.
If you find anything else while
you're in Juperos, please come back and show it to me, alright?
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
哦。這裡沒有什麼能對我研究有幫助的東西，
但還是謝謝你。
如果你在朱佩羅斯發現其他東西，
請回來給我看看，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Is this another
Transparent Plate?
Yes, it's quite different
than the last one you
brought over to me...
This is so exciting!
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
這是另一塊透明碟仙惡靈嗎？
是的，它和你上次帶來的那塊很不一樣...
這太令人興奮了！

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Oh. You must be thinking
that I'm a complete academia
addict. Well, my life might be
a little uneventful, but there
are other things I think about!
Like, well... It's weird but...
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
哦。你一定覺得我是個徹底的學術狂人。
嗯，我的生活可能有點平淡，
但我也有其他思考的事情！
比如，嗯...這很奇怪，但是...

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
You see, there's this
guy that I like. I'm not sure
where he might be now, but
his name is Nadim Amal. He's
my friend's brother who I first
met 10 years ago. ^333333*Sigh...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
你看，有個我喜歡的傢伙。
我不確定他現在在哪裡，
但他叫納迪姆·阿馬爾。他是
我朋友的哥哥，我10年前第一次見到他。 ^333333*嘆氣...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Just recently, I saw
him with his sister, my
friend from Morocc. It's
weird to think that I'd have
these feelings for him after
all this time, isn't it? Oh...!
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
最近，我看到他和他的姐姐，
我在摩洛哥的朋友在一起。想到
在這麼長時間後我會有這種感覺，
是不是很奇怪？哦...！

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
I really should repay
you for this Transparent
Plate. Why don't I tell you
the scariest story that I know?
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
我真的應該回報你這塊透明碟仙惡靈。
不如我告訴你我所知道的最恐怖的故事？

scripts.text:
^3355FFFayruz tells you a
creepy horror story that
makes you shiver with fear.
You've heard other ghost
stories, but you've never been
so deeply immersed in one before.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF法伊魯茲給你講了一個
令人毛骨悚然的恐怖故事，
讓你嚇得發抖。
你聽過其他鬼故事，
但從未如此深刻地沉浸在一個故事中。^000000

scripts.text:
It is only when the
story ends and you return
to your senses that you notice that you're soaked in cold sweat.^000000
scripts.translation:
當故事結束，你回過神來，
才注意到自己已經冷汗直流。^000000

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
It may be a natural
response, but all people
fear the unknown in one way
or another. Scary stories are
appealing because we actually
like the strange and grotesque.
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
這可能是一種自然的反應，
但所有人都在某種程度上
害怕未知。恐怖故事之所以吸引人，
是因為我們實際上喜歡怪異和醜陋的東西。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Well... That's just my
opinion. Anyway, if you
find anything else in Juperos
that may help in my research,
please come back and show it
to me, alright? See you later~
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
嗯...這只是我的觀點。總之，如果你在朱佩羅斯
找到了任何可能對我的研究有幫助的東西，
請回來給我看，好嗎？回頭見~

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Oh, this one seems
to have been created
in a similar era as the
one you gave me earlier.
I'm not sure how much new
information this may provide...
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
哦，這個似乎與你之前給我的那個
製作於相似的時代。
我不確定這能提供多少新資訊...

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Still, I'm sure this will
helpful in my research. I just
won't be as making progress
as quickly as I had projected.
Please, I'd like you to take this as a token of my gratitude.
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
不過，我相信這對我的研究會有幫助。
只是我的進展不會像我預期的那樣快。
請收下這個，作為我感謝你的禮物。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Now if you'll excuse
me, I need to go back
to compiling my research...
Thank you so much for
your help, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
現在，請原諒我，
我需要回去整理我的研究了...
非常感謝你的幫助，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Oh. There isn't anything
here that would help in my
research, but thank you anyway.
If you find anything else while
you're in Juperos, please come back and show it to me, alright?
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
哦。這裡沒有什麼能對我研究有幫助的東西，
但還是謝謝你。
如果你在朱佩羅斯發現其他東西，
請回來給我看看，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Oooh...! This one is
much different than the
other ones you gave me
before. This should provide
a wealth of brand new insights
into the Juperos civilization!
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
哦...！這個和你之前給我的其他
碟仙惡靈很不一樣。這應該能提供
大量關於朱佩羅斯文明的全新見解！

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
All the Transparent
Plates you've given me
should contain more than
enough data for me to fully
complete my research thesis.
Once again, thank you so much~
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
你給我的所有透明碟仙惡靈
應該包含足夠的資料，讓我
完全完成我的研究論文。
再次非常感謝你~

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Still, that doesn't mean that
I will stop collecting data for
my research. Anyway, I have one last story to tell you, about
a man of pure heart chosen by the gods to serve and protect mankind.
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
不過，這並不意味著我會停止
為我的研究收集資料。總之，我還有最後一個故事要告訴你，
關於一個被神選中，
為保護人類而服務的純愛之心之人。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
For this purpose he was given
gaudy armor which contained
amazing powers, as well as a
book detailing the instructions
for its use. However, he promptly
lost these instructions...
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
為了這個目的，他被賦予了
華麗的盔甲，其中包含
神奇的力量，以及一本
詳細說明其使用方法的書籍。然而，他很快就
丟失了這些說明書...

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe story about the
greatest Juperosian hero
that Fayruz tells you is very
humorous at first, but then it
covers the entire spectrum
of emotion and humanity...
scripts.translation:
^3355FF法伊魯茲為你講述的這位朱佩羅斯最偉大的英雄的故事，起初非常幽默，
隨後卻涵蓋了人類情感與人性中所有的悲喜...

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe story ends and you
are left with a swelling
feeling of indefatigable
hope and inspiration...
You can make it if you try!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF故事結束了，
你心中湧起一股
不可動搖的希望與靈感...
只要努力，就能做到！^000000

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Well, that is the
last and the best story
that I have to share
with you. Perhaps next
time, I'll fill you in on my
research progress~
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
好了，這就是我要
分享給你的最後一個
也是最好的故事。
也許下次，我會告訴你
我的研究進展~

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Hmm...
This one seems to be created in a similar time
as the previous one.
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
嗯...
這個似乎和之前那個
是在同一時期製作的。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Don't you worry.
This will help my research of course,
although I do not think this will
help me in advancing my research
with a great speed unlike this other one.
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
別擔心。
這當然會對我的研究有幫助，
雖然我覺得它不像
那個那樣能讓我
以極快的速度推進研究。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Please take this as a token of my gratitude.
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
請收下這個，
作為我的一點心意。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Now, excuse me. I need to go back to my research.
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
那麼，失陪了。
我需要回去繼續研究了。

scripts.text:
[Fayruz]
Oh. There isn't anything
here that would help in my
research, but thank you anyway.
If you find anything else while
you're in Juperos, please come back and show it to me, alright?
scripts.translation:
[法伊魯茲]
哦。這裡沒有什麼能對我研究有幫助的東西，
但還是謝謝你。
如果你在朱佩羅斯發現其他東西，
請回來給我看看，好嗎？

scripts.translation:
^8B6914關於朱佩羅斯衰落的原因

就目前而言，我們擁有的

scripts.text:

data on the civilization of

scripts.translation:

a thousand years ago in
an era of peace just after
a major war. Contrary to
popular belief, there isn't any
evidence proving that Juno may
have descended from Juperos.^000000

scripts.text:

strong possibility that
another war, between Juno
and Juperos, resulted in Juno's

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou take out your
Crest Piece and place
it into the slot where it
happens to fit perfectly.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你拿出旗幟塗鴉，
將它放入插槽中，
它正好完美地契合。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFNothing happens.
Perhaps an alarm or
some other safety measure
was activated to keep the
Crest Piece from activating
this transportation device.
You retrieve the Crest Piece.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF什麼也沒發生。
也許是某種警報
或其他安全措施被激活了，
以防止旗幟塗鴉
啟動這個傳送裝置。
你收回了旗幟塗鴉。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe slot rotates and
the Crest Piece moves as
if it were turning a key. You
feel a weak tremor as a Warp
Portal to the other side is
activated. You then retrieve
your Crest Piece.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF插槽轉動，
旗幟塗鴉像鑰匙一樣轉動。
你感覺到一陣微弱的震動，
通往另一邊的傳送門被激活了。
然後你收回了旗幟塗鴉。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFUnfortunately, you're
not carrying anything
that might be able to fit
into the slot and activate
this mechanical device.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF不幸的是，
你沒有攜帶任何
可能適合插入插槽
並啟動這個機械裝置的物品。^000000

^3355FFIt's a lever
whose function
is not known to you.^000000

scripts.translation: 拉動

what will happen...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
拉動這個槓桿？
我甚至不知道
會發生什麼...

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's some sort of
lever that looks like
it was already pulled
by someone else.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這是一種看起來
像是已經被別人
拉動過的槓桿。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's some sort of
lever that's located
next to four empty slots.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這是一個位於四個空槽位旁邊的槓桿。^000000

scripts.text: Pull the lever.
scripts.translation: 拉動槓桿

scripts.text: Leave it alone.
scripts.translation: 先放著吧。

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Snap Snap*^000000

^3355FFYou pull the lever,
but nothing happened.
You probably need to
insert the correct objects
into the slots in order
for the lever to operate.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你拉動了槓桿，但什麼也沒發生。
看來你需要將正確的物品放入槽位中，槓桿才能運作。^000000

scripts.text: Insert all of your Crest Pieces.
scripts.translation: 放入所有的紋章碎片

scripts.text:
^3300FF*Snap!*^000000
^3300FFStrangely enough,
all four of the Crest
Pieces fit perfectly into
the slots and begin to
emit a strange light.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3300FF*咔噠！*^000000
^3300FF奇怪的是，四塊紋章碎片完美地嵌入了槽位，並開始散發出奇異的光芒。^000000

scripts.text: Pull out the Crest Pieces.
scripts.translation: 取出紋章碎片

scripts.text: Pull the lever.
scripts.translation: 拉動槓桿

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou pull out all
the Crest Pieces
that you inserted
into the slots.^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's strange,
but this lever has
already been pulled.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這很奇怪，但這個槓桿似乎已經被拉動過了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFOnce you pull the lever,
the Crest Piece slots are
suddenly covered, making
them irretrievable, and the
ground begins to shake
violently. This isn't normal!^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF一旦拉動槓桿，紋章碎片的槽位就會突然被覆蓋，導致無法取出，地面也會開始劇烈震動。這不對勁！^000000

scripts.text: Insert Crest Pieces.
scripts.translation: 放入紋章碎片

scripts.text:
^3355FFRight now, you don't
have enough Crest Pieces
to place into all four of these
slots. You'll need to find and^FFFFFF ^3355FF bring them all to make this work.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF目前，你擁有的紋章碎片不足以填滿這四個插槽。你需要找到它們，^FFFFFF ^3355FF並將它們全部帶來才能使其運作。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou need to find
some kind of object
that you can fit into
each of these four slots...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你需要找到某種可以放入這四個槽位的物品...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWho knows what
this lever may do?
You'll never know unless
you have the courage to try.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF誰知道這個槓桿會有什麼作用？
除非你有勇氣去嘗試，否則永遠無法知道。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt seems like
someone else is

^3355FFIt's a Warp Portal
that will teleport you
to the previous floor.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這是一個傳送之陣，可以將你傳送到上一層。^000000
